description: Accept a buyer's proposed purchase order (the seller approving). Stamps the agreement and emits po.accepted back to the buyer; both stamps make it agreed and draft the invoice.

thread.description: The PO thread being accepted (from the inbound po.proposed).

items.description: The terms being accepted (must match the proposal), each {description, qty}.

total.description: The agreed total (must match the proposal).

terms_hash.description: Optional fingerprint from the proposal; recomputed from items+total if omitted.
